# Paper H: Harbor QA Sheet

## h1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_harbor; SECTION_KEY=h1_scope]
Paper Harbor Sheet USES HarborQA. HarborQA TARGETS Dataset Grounding by requiring every answer to cite retrieved chunks.

## h2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_harbor; SECTION_KEY=h2_dataset]
HarborQA is EVALUATED_ON AuroraSet. This creates a cross-document bridge because AtlasRetriever is also evaluated on AuroraSet.

## h3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_harbor; SECTION_KEY=h3_metric]
HarborQA REPORTS Source Hit Rate. The metric is reused to verify that grounded answers cite at least one source chunk.

## h4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_harbor; SECTION_KEY=h4_concept]
HarborQA USES Semantic Drift. Semantic Drift is a Concept describing how paraphrased questions can move away from exact document words.

## h5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_harbor; SECTION_KEY=h5_compare]
Paper Harbor Sheet COMPARES_WITH GradientMemo. The comparison contrasts grounded QA with experiment memory recall.
